catalog.name: HKG Community Catalog
catalog.publisher: loredous, with the Gen5W NEMESIS community

packages.description: Port of SmartTube, a YouTube client, for the head unit. Works only in Park. Needs the media.codecs package (2.0 or newer) from KramerTech/gen5-codec-patch installed first.
packages.author: KramerTech

packages.description: Records the backup camera to a USB drive in the head unit and adds a player app. Not for cars with a 360-degree camera (the installer refuses). Restart the head unit after installing. Experimental.
packages.author: KramerTech

packages.description: Dismisses the startup confirmation screen that normally needs a tap before the infotainment can be used. This version has not been tested on a car yet.
packages.author: armandodollia

packages.description: Reverses the steering-wheel track buttons. Made for the Kia EV6 (tested on a 2023 EV6 GT-Line, US). Needs a full head unit restart (hold the volume knob about 10 seconds).
packages.author: dibble9012

packages.description: Brings Apple CarPlay to the front as soon as it connects, wired or wireless. Tested on a 2025 Kia EV6 GT-Line (US).
packages.author: dibble9012

packages.description: Launchpad: a manual battery preconditioning button and other shortcuts, opened by holding the TUNE knob. Restart the head unit after installing. See the project's compatibility chart.
packages.author: paytondevs

packages.description: On every start, turns on the heated steering wheel and seats when it's cold outside. Set the app's temperature unit to match your cluster (F or C).
packages.author: eclipseempire

packages.description: Watches the 12V battery and warns on the car's screen before a weak battery or a charging problem. Read-only. Pauses itself on firmware it doesn't know.
packages.author: zpoon

packages.description: Adds a climate page to the right-side split screen: one-tap seat heating and cooling, the outside temperature, and preset buttons that apply several climate settings at once.
packages.author: loredous
